name: Backpressure + Bounded Concurrency
summary: Introduce backpressure and bounded concurrency to prevent queue growth and cascading overload.

use_when.message: Large queue backlog suggests consumer throughput mismatch or unbounded production.

avoid_when.message: Very high request latency suggests end-to-end overload; ensure producers also degrade gracefully (rate limiting).

solutions: Cap consumer concurrency and implement adaptive scaling based on lag
Apply producer rate limiting / shedding to keep the system stable
Add a dead-letter queue (DLQ) and poison-message handling
tradeoffs: Throughput may drop under load (by design)
May surface upstream rate limiting needs
